title: Dauntless Unbroken
description: Dauntless Unbroken is now running 1.10.5. These notes cover our changes and the issues still being investigated.

sections.title: Welcome to 1.10.5
sections.description: Use your existing Unbroken account key with the current public launcher.

list: Game downloads use Cloudflare R2 with resume support and file verification.
Ramsgate, Training Grounds and Hunting Grounds are available.

sections.title: Accounts and cosmetics
sections.description: Existing accounts carry their inventory and progression into the new realm.

list: Legacy cosmetic records are converted to the item format used by 1.10.5 when inventory loads.
The conversion keeps recovery records and does not reset equipment or cells.
Main-shop cosmetic offers use Rams; the displayed price is checked again when purchasing.

sections.title: Reliability fixes
sections.description: This update addresses stale hunt servers and conflicting bounty slots.

list: Hunt allocation checks fresh game activity before assigning a world.
Unresponsive hunt processes are retired after a grace period.
Ordinary bounties and seasonal challenges no longer replace each other when they use the same slot number.
Quest dialogue and Training Grounds routing have been corrected.
Public matchmaking groups eligible requests for the same hunt; private hunts stay limited to you and your party.
Launcher 1.0.53 corrects the Rams price and currency icon on shop cards.
Main-shop offers rotate weekly, with Recruit dye always available for its quest.
Middleman fusion recipes use a one-hour wait. Existing timers are not restarted.

sections.title: Issues under investigation
sections.description: Please upload launcher logs after an error so we can investigate your session.

list: Some players still report hunt timeouts or Escalation cancellations.
Weapon meters, lanterns, consumables and zero-health states still need further gameplay validation.
Missing items and bounty rewards are being checked; report the item or bounty name with your account name.
Omnicell HUD and activation reports, Lightbound Koshai effects and Slayer Link reward display are still under investigation.
